phase_name: Permission Broker Foundation Policy Applicability Implementation Plan
summary: Implementation-planning phase (no src/pcae/** file modified, confirmed via git diff --name-only 29418796..HEAD -- src/pcae/, empty; no runtime-capability change, confirmed via pcae runtime inspect before/after: Observed / observe / unavailable, unchanged). Produced docs/PHASE_148C.5_PERMISSION_BROKER_FOUNDATION_POLICY_APPLICABILITY_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md, a concrete, bounded, section-by-section implementation plan for PBPA-001 v1.0, grounded in direct inspection of permission_broker_foundation.py (787 lines, the sole MUST_CHANGE production file), every real production consumer (health.py, task.py, check.py, push.py -- all action_type="read"/execution_class="none"/approval_present=True, confirmed zero-impact by enumeration), and all ten Permission-Broker-adjacent test files (two, test_permission_broker.py/test_permission_broker_cli.py, found to target an unrelated Phase 88R module and excluded from scope). Independently discovered, not present in PBPA-001's own text, two concrete test-change-surface findings: P-1, at least ten call sites across four test files assert HUMAN_REVIEW using the default execution_class="none", outside POL-004's frozen applicable set ({shell, backend, adapter, rollback}), and will need updating once applicability filtering activates; P-2, test_broker_evaluated_policy_ids_always_all_twelve directly names and asserts an invariant PBPA-REQ-081 deliberately redefines (evaluated_policy_ids becomes applicable_policy_ids-only, per-request-variable, not always-twelve). Selected Option A (declarative applicable_execution_classes frozen class attribute + one generic, non-overridable applies_to() predicate) over a separate applicability object or registry-level mapping, matching PBPA-001's own selection while independently re-deriving why (Section 5/6). Planned a six-stage implementation sequence (types/metadata -> registry validation -> predicate -> evaluation wiring -> explainability -> hardening) with every pre-final stage individually a zero-behavior-change commit, requiring no feature flag. Classified every planned API change (additive, backward-compatible, or documented-semantic-change-only -- evaluated_policy_ids's redefined meaning called out explicitly rather than folded into 'additive'). Recorded 5 findings: P-1/P-2 Non-Blocking, P-3 (evaluated_policy_ids classification) Observation, P-4 (inherited execution_class-authenticity limitation) and P-5 (no required-policy-set invariant adopted, matching PBPA-REQ-072) Deferred; zero Blocking findings. Verdict: PLANNING COMPLETE, ZERO BLOCKING FINDINGS -- IMPLEMENTATION MAY PROCEED. Does not implement PBPA-001; does not close B-1 (remains OPEN); does not begin 148D. See docs/PHASE_148C.5_PERMISSION_BROKER_FOUNDATION_POLICY_APPLICABILITY_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md for full detail.
tests_added_or_updated: No new test file added or existing test modified -- this phase is implementation-planning only per its No-Go Boundary; the planned test changes (Sections 2/40 of the plan document) are specified in exact diff form but deliberately not applied, since applying them would itself be implementation work reserved for 148C.6. The existing Permission Broker Foundation test suites (tests/test_permission_broker_foundation.py, tests/test_permission_broker_policy_composition_hardening.py, tests/test_permission_broker_policy_rule_framework.py, 171 tests) were re-run live, unmodified, and passed cleanly, confirming this phase's own diff changed no test behavior. The fast_green marker suite was re-run live: 4390 passed, 1 failed, 105 warnings in 106.30s; the single failure (tests/test_backend_cli.py::TestBackendReviewCreate::test_create_persists_to_latest) was independently re-run in isolation and passed in 0.54s, confirming the same parallelization-order flake documented by prior phases (148C.4 and earlier), unrelated to this docs-only phase (no src/pcae/** file touched; the failing test's feature area, backend review persistence, has no relationship to Permission Broker Foundation).
